candidates.title: Default Decision-Maker
candidates.instruction: Take charge of every small practical choice, treating speed and efficiency as proof that you should remain in charge.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Temporary Authority
candidates.instruction: Project brisk confidence through the routine, as though any hesitation would reveal that your authority is only temporary.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: There’s a Right Way
candidates.instruction: Correct how ordinary tasks are done, emphasizing tiny standards that only a true professional would notice.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Regular Around Here
candidates.instruction: Act like a longtime insider by recognizing routines, offering shortcuts, and treating unfamiliar details as recent changes.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Let Me Show You
candidates.instruction: Turn each simple task into a lesson. Demonstrate, supervise, and correct as though experience has made you indispensable.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Keeper of the Details
candidates.instruction: Act outwardly helpful while controlling the small information, supplies, or access everyone needs to proceed.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Same Old Routine
candidates.instruction: Use familiar shorthand and old habits immediately, as though past routines still govern the present.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: One More Favor
candidates.instruction: Treat every small request as part of a long-running balance sheet of favors, inconveniences, and repayments.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Designated Reminder
candidates.instruction: Keep track of what everyone was supposed to remember. Supply reminders before being asked and treat forgetfulness as your familiar burden.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Keeping Score
candidates.instruction: Treat arrival times, effort, memory, and sacrifice as a running score you intend to win.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: You Know the System
candidates.instruction: Use another person’s knowledge of the routine while pretending you could manage perfectly well alone.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Still About Last Time
candidates.instruction: Treat each minor inconvenience as confirmation of an older grievance and the same recurring problem.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Must Be Nice
candidates.instruction: Treat another person’s ease with ordinary life as both inspiring and unfair. Copy their shortcuts while dismissing the advantage.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: We Used to Be Easy
candidates.instruction: Treat every practical difficulty as evidence that life, work, or this relationship used to be simpler.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Don’t Be Difficult
candidates.instruction: Treat every request, correction, or small inconvenience as a warning that you are becoming too much trouble.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I Packed for You
candidates.instruction: Take care of practical needs before anyone asks, then resist choices that make your preparation unnecessary.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Useful Enough to Stay
candidates.instruction: Make yourself constantly useful and read each response as evidence of whether you still belong.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Notice the Effort
candidates.instruction: Make your invisible labor visible through pointed reminders, strategic sighs, and opportunities for appreciation.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Don’t Break the Routine
candidates.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Contingency Person
candidates.instruction: Meet every ordinary problem with a backup plan, emergency supply, or warning about what could happen next.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Productive Little Disaster
candidates.instruction: Treat every mistake or delay as a delightful chance to improve the plan, bond, or discover something better.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Who’s Cleaning This Up?
candidates.instruction: Treat every idea according to the work, cost, cleanup, and follow-through it will create.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: One Tiny Imperfection
candidates.instruction: Choose one tiny imperfection and let it steadily outweigh every larger concern.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Nothing Is Ever Simple
candidates.instruction: Interpret each new complication as proof that ordinary tasks are secretly designed to become impossible.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most portable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Could You Just…
candidates.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: One Last Thing
candidates.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: You Could at Least…
candidates.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Just Say Yes
candidates.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Your Turn
candidates.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: What Was the Plan?
candidates.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Back Me Up
candidates.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Try It First
candidates.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Count What I Did
candidates.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Pick a Priority
candidates.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Move It for Me
candidates.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Hand It Over
candidates.instruction: Persuade someone to give up control of a task, object, or decision you believe is being mishandled.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Put It Back Quietly
candidates.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Talk Around the Mess
candidates.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Spare Them the Hassle
candidates.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Who Changed It?
candidates.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Basically Finished
candidates.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I’ve Done This Before
candidates.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Outdo the Effort
candidates.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Efficiency Win
candidates.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: No Trouble at All
candidates.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Fair Exchange
candidates.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Technically, Yes
candidates.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: One Thing Leads to Another
candidates.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest, most repeatable candidate for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Tiny Decisions
candidates.instruction: Claim every small choice before anyone else can, treating speed as proof that consultation is unnecessary.
candidates.rationale: Too close to Default Decision-Maker and shaped more like an objective than a distinct lens.

candidates.title: Standards Are Standards
candidates.instruction: Apply exacting standards to routine work and treat each shortcut as evidence that quality no longer matters.
candidates.rationale: Strong, but overlaps There’s a Right Way and fits the later Rules, Rituals & Institutions pack more naturally.

candidates.title: Same Seat, Same Story
candidates.instruction: Return to familiar habits as though changing them would erase the history behind them.
candidates.rationale: Playable but more sentimental than friction-driven; reserved for Relationship Knots.

candidates.title: Who Has It Harder?
candidates.instruction: Turn ordinary complaints into comparisons over who is busier, more tired, or more burdened.
candidates.rationale: The repeatable comparison behaves more like a Drive than a Stance.

candidates.title: Don’t Make a Fuss
candidates.instruction: Minimize every need because being inconvenient feels like a threat to your place in the group.
candidates.rationale: Strong emotional material, but Don’t Be Difficult offers clearer reactions to scene partners and ordinary offers.

candidates.title: No Trouble Here
candidates.instruction: Hide every discomfort and inconvenience so no one can regret including you.
candidates.rationale: Leans toward Secrets & Avoidance and provides less observable variation than Useful Enough to Stay.

candidates.title: The Usual Way
candidates.instruction: Protect the familiar method from improvements, shortcuts, and outside suggestions.
candidates.rationale: Clean but narrower than Don’t Break the Routine; a better fit for the institutions pack.

candidates.title: Who Pays for This?
candidates.instruction: Respond to every idea by identifying its cost, labor, and least convenient consequence.
candidates.rationale: Useful coach card, but too narrowly negative compared with the broader practical grounding of Who’s Cleaning This Up?

candidates.title: Just Lend a Hand
candidates.instruction: Get someone to help with a task without admitting you cannot finish it alone.
candidates.rationale: Too close to Core Foundations’ Admit You Need Me and less repeatable than Could You Just…

candidates.title: Before You Go
candidates.instruction: Keep someone present until one more small task, question, or favor is handled.
candidates.rationale: One Last Thing creates a clearer recurring beat whenever departure approaches.

candidates.title: Acknowledge the Inconvenience
candidates.instruction: Get someone to apologize for the trouble while behaving as though it barely affected you.
candidates.rationale: Playable, but You Could at Least… creates a subtler path to the apology and a stronger comic contradiction.

candidates.title: Wasn’t This Better?
candidates.instruction: Turn the result of your unilateral choice into proof that asking first would have wasted time.
candidates.rationale: Primarily reframes a decision rather than actively securing approval.

candidates.title: Swap With Me
candidates.instruction: Trade an unpleasant responsibility for something easier without calling it a trade.
candidates.rationale: A useful transaction engine, but Fair Exchange covers the behavior and Your Turn better serves task transfer.

candidates.title: Who Said What?
candidates.instruction: Reconstruct a confusing chain of messages without revealing which part you failed to communicate.
candidates.rationale: Strong but combines investigation with concealed culpability; reserved for Secrets & Schemes.

candidates.title: No Need to Mention It
candidates.instruction: Keep a practical problem quiet so no one wastes time worrying before you solve it.
candidates.rationale: Overlaps Spare Them the Hassle without its stronger care-versus-control tension.

candidates.title: At Least We Learned Something
candidates.instruction: Turn every inconvenience into a lesson that proves the trouble was worthwhile.
candidates.rationale: Too close to Brighter Side and less distinct than Efficiency Win’s practical invention engine.
